lifetime.reuse: On nonzero runtimecount the second builder phase reuses existing nonnull row.base, updating only records selected by sourceflag bit2; it does not allocate each actor or each transition.
lifetime.reset: 1B8F0 stores0 to runtime count40BC6, then calls1F360,1CE10,1D320 and tailcalls1D860 to reset actor pools; actual sidecar free invocation is not proved by that count reset alone. Actor base reset1D8A0 clears offset+58 and profile+38.
lifetime.transition: Transition clears actor.kind and the recordflags highbit; it does not free row allocation or erase actor offset itself on that path. Later reset clears offset. Actors borrow positions in a row allocation; they do not own its pointer.
lifetime.host_limit: Generic host allocation header preserves owner slot; host_free can clear it and shrink/compaction can move/update it. The observed relative offset can survive a base relocation, but no specific compaction/free call on these rows or global lifetime schedule is claimed.

limits: Native offset/base roles are proved on these producer paths. Exact original signedness/type/static row capacity, complete lifetime and original compilation units are unproved. Unused strict-source views are unchanged.
